scope: Offline standard-candle full-script execution; no network/data acquisition in the runtime
scripts: frozen original Relative Strength Index, default inputs
frozen original Relative Strength Index, SMA+BB and divergence inputs from native alternate reference
frozen original Pivot Points Standard, Traditional/Auto daily-based inputs
sessionScheduling: Interleaved independent sessions in one process; do not label this as parallel throughput

data.chart: Deterministic positive synthetic standard OHLCV minute bars, generator/source/input hashes recorded before execution
data.pivotProvider: Completed daily bars for historical seed; separately delivered cumulative daily forming/confirmation events during live tail
data.seedBoundary: Align historical seed end to a daily close so the forming provider starts after completed provider history
data.nativeReference: Synthetic resource data is not native TradingView numerical evidence

requiredEvidence: Actual installed/built artifact hashes, source identity, host CPU/RAM, runtime versions and build profiles
Measured operation counts equal planned counts; no warmup/tail omission or silent truncation
Historical batch versus incremental final-output parity under identical input context
Live sequence repeatability and streaming-replica parity; do not force live output to equal historical lookahead output
Independent session isolation with distinct input streams and one compiled source where supported
Separate update, request-update, snapshot/serialization and peak-memory measurements
No concurrent compilation or other known benchmark jobs during acceptance measurement
Failures/timeouts and all repeated trials retained; no budget relaxation after measuring
acceptance: Not evaluated. Every required script/platform/surface/history/session-count case must meet its budget and correctness checks. An unavailable case remains unverified.
measurementImplementation: Each receipt must pin the actual committed implementation and artifact hashes; source repairs may advance the baseline while frozen workloads/budgets remain unchanged
